summary_en: The video presents a step-by-step cooking guide for stir-fried oysters with broccoli in a modern kitchen studio setting. It covers introducing ingredients, preparing and blanching vegetables, stir-frying the oysters and vegetables with seasonings, and plating the final dish. In the concluding segment, two male hosts showcase the finished meal and invite the audience to participate in a program survey.
